title: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線
summary: 鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線以「港區貨運列車的阻力制動與容量協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。專用貨運線把港區裝卸、列車編組與幹線運行連成同一條物流鏈，列車較長與較重會同時改變加速、制動及站場占用，單看最高速度不足以推估吞吐量。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops coordinating freight resistance braking and port capacity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A dedicated freight line links port handling, train assembly and mainline movement; longer heavier trains change acceleration, braking and yard occupation together, so maximum speed alone does not determine throughput. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 列車單向運能與坡道牽引分力
stages.titleEn: Directional train throughput & Gradient traction force
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車單向運能」與「坡道牽引分力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Directional train throughput" and "Gradient traction force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車單向運能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Directional train throughput: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車單向運能」如何影響鹿特丹港貝圖威貨運線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Directional train throughput” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Betuweroute freight railway”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 運能是班次與有效載重的乘積，空車回送及車站衝突仍會消耗路徑。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9900 t/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求。使用滿載率與實際發車間距作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車單向運能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Throughput multiplies departures by useful payload, while empty returns and conflicting moves still consume paths. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9900 t/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns. Use load factor and actual departure intervals as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Directional train throughput” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車單向運能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Directional train throughput”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車單向運能
knowledge.text: 運能是班次與有效載重的乘積，空車回送及車站衝突仍會消耗路徑。本模型把 n 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9900 t/h。
knowledge.textEn: Throughput multiplies departures by useful payload, while empty returns and conflicting moves still consume paths. In this model, n is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車單向運能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Directional train throughput" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量
運能是班次與有效載重的乘積，空車回送及車站衝突仍會消耗路徑。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow.
Throughput multiplies departures by useful payload, while empty returns and conflicting moves still consume paths.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force.
quiz.explanation: 運能是班次與有效載重的乘積，空車回送及車站衝突仍會消耗路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Throughput multiplies departures by useful payload, while empty returns and conflicting moves still consume paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車單向運能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Directional train throughput: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車單向運能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Directional train throughput” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=9900 t/h。模型邊界：固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=9900 t/h. Boundary: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=9900 t/h。模型邊界：固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=9900 t/h. Boundary: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車單向運能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Directional train throughput", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只計算穩態制動段會低估長車列停車距離
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略列車長度會讓理論班距低於實際占用
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only steady braking underestimates a long consist stopping distance.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring train length produces a theoretical headway below real occupancy.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train；y=n*q=9000 t/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=5 trains/h, q=1800 t/train; y=n*q=9000 t/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列車單向運能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Directional train throughput: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車單向運能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Directional train throughput” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車單向運能」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using yard departure timestamps and cargo weighing records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Directional train throughput. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「列車單向運能」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量造成偏離的合成觀察，以滿載率與實際發車間距說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Directional train throughput, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. Explain which evidence in load factor and actual departure intervals distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「列車單向運能」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using yard departure timestamps and cargo weighing records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Directional train throughput. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「列車單向運能」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定每列有效載重與發車率，不含尖峰到達或空車需求如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量造成偏離的合成觀察，以滿載率與實際發車間距說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. Explain which evidence in load factor and actual departure intervals distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車單向運能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Directional train throughput"?
options: 本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：到達成群時平均庫存可能掩蓋短時壅塞
optionsEn: Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bunched arrivals can hide short congestion behind a moderate average inventory.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以滿載率與實際發車間距區分模型與觀察，先用站場發車時間戳與貨物秤重帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use load factor and actual departure intervals to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列車單向運能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Directional train throughput: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列車單向運能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Directional train throughput” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量。這個失效與「列車單向運能」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查滿載率與實際發車間距，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Directional train throughput can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load factor and actual departure intervals rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用滿載率與實際發車間距作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把額定載重當實際載重會高估貨物流量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using rated payload as actual payload overstates cargo flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。這個失效與「坡道牽引分力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查坡度定位與車列總重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. This failure and a measurement bias in Gradient traction force can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check gradient location and total consist mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡道牽引分力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gradient traction force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把低速最大牽引力延用到高速會超出功率邊界
忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending maximum low-speed force to high speed exceeds the power boundary.
Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force.
quiz.explanation: 忽略尾車仍在另一坡段會誤算整列車受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring wagons still on another gradient miscalculates total force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
